review: phase2-funder-review workflow, 2026-08-03: 27 agents (8 batch reviewers + adversarial verifiers over every proposed exclusion/rename), 95 funders reviewed, plus an orchestrator sweep matching every published row's recipient address against the filer's own address across all cached filings.

decisions.lefkofsky_207066362: Reviewer proposed exclusion (all rows are quarantined placeholders); verifier upheld. NOT applied: the pipeline had already published zero rows, and the aggregate_only disposition is the truthful register entry — it keeps the funder on the funder-exchange target list ($23.9M quarantined) instead of relabeling it as a review casualty.
decisions.feinberg_237028857: Caught by the orchestrator's filer-address sweep, not the batch review: all 504 rows across four filings (about $14.3M) list the foundation's own office as every recipient address. Real recipient names, reconciled dollars, fabricated geography (city attribution included). Held whole as excluded_filings; premier funder-exchange ask — the itemization exists, only the addresses are missing.
decisions.rrf_362429540_fy2023: Filer-address artifact on FY2023 only (231/231 rows; FY2024 files real addresses); also carries a -$4.4M prior-year-payables contra row that ties line 3a while the positive rows overstate the year. Held FY2023 whole; other years publish normally.
decisions.malott_363680666: Three rows per year are transfers into the officers' own donor-advised vehicles at the family-office address ($3.4M total, 20-39% of its would-be Chicago total). Held as excluded_rows.
decisions.coleman_363025967: 'Matching Gifts - Details Available upon request' at the foundation's own address, all four years ($425,969). Held, and the placeholder-family regex in the export now covers the 'available upon request' shape structurally.
decisions.polsky_651164639: Two FY2024 rows ($3.26M) list the filer's One S Wacker office for non-Chicago recipients (BRCA Research and Cure Alliance, Our Home Ukraine). Held as excluded_rows.
decisions.tull_356932298: Sole FY2023 row ($500k, Neuroscience Research Foundation) at the filer's own address. Held.
decisions.kennedy_367014327: FY2024 no_control_total is a genuine zero-grant year (explicit $0 contributions paid, $8,759 total expenses) — nothing missing, nothing to load.
decisions.busch_trust_136753472: Identity flag: BMF name says Charles Busch Cemetary Trust but the e-file filer name is a Rutgers University UW trust and the sole grantee is Rutgers (NJ). Zero Chicago rows so nothing publishes; flagged for operator awareness before any future surfacing.
decisions.mondelez_203881590: Structural break: TY2023+ routes employee giving through an online-giving intermediary, so its Chicago itemization collapses by construction (20 -> 1 rows). Any per-year trend on this funder needs that caveat.

note: The 13 hq-outside-chicago funders are predominantly JPMorgan/bank trust-desk filings whose BMF city is Chicago because the TRUSTEE is; most publish zero Chicago recipient rows and therefore contribute capacity coverage (we checked) without contributing rows.
